text.en:
1. (1) Kaedah-kaedah ini bolehlah dinamakan Kaedah-Kaedah Kenderaan

Perkhidmatan Awam (Pelesenan dan Tatakelakuan Pemandu, Konduktor dan

Penumpang) (Pindaan) 2013.

(2) Kaedah-Kaedah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 15 Mac 2013.

Pindaan kaedah 3

2. Kaedah-Kaedah Kenderaan Perkhidmatan Awam (Pelesenan dan Tatakelakuan

Pemandu, Konduktor dan Penumpang) 1959 [L.N. 177/1959], yang disebut

"Kaedah-Kaedah ibu" dalam Kaedah-Kaedah ini, dipinda dalam kaedah 3—

(a) dalam subkaedah (1), dengan menggantikan perkataan "prescribed fee"

dengan perkataan "payment of fee as prescribed in item 1 of Table A of

the Schedule"; dan

(b) dengan memasukkan selepas subkaedah (2) subkaedah yang berikut:

 "(3) Where the applicant of a licence is the holder of a licence

issued under the Goods Vehicles (Licensing of Drivers) Rules 1965

[L.N. 158/1965], the fee referred to in subrule (1) shall not apply.

(4) The applicant of a licence referred to in subrule (3) shall be

subject to the fee as prescribed in item 2 of Table A of the Schedule.

"Renewal of

 a licence.

 (5) Upon receipt of the application for a licence, the date of

expiry of the licence shall be in accordance with the date of birth of the

holder of a licence.".

Kaedah baru 3A dan 3B

3. Kaedah-Kaedah ibu dipinda dengan memasukkan selepas kaedah 3 kaedah yang

berikut:

 3A. (1) A holder of a licence may apply for

renewal of a licence before the date of expiry of such licence.

 (2) Where the holder of a licence whose date

of birth falls on 29 February, the date of expiry of his

licence is either—

(a) 28 February, if the following

application for renewal of the licence

is made in a year which is not a leap

year; or

(b) 29 February, if the following

application for renewal of the licence

is made in a year which is a leap year,

as the case may be.

 (3) Upon receipt of the application for renewal of

the licence—

(a) the date of expiry of the licence shall

be in accordance with the date of

birth of the holder of a licence; and

Adjustment

for the date

of expiry of

a licence.

(b) the existing licence together with proof

of payment and renewal of such

licence shall be sufficient evidence that

the holder of a licence is the holder of

a valid licence.

(4) The fee for renewal of the licence shall be as

prescribed in item 1 of Table A of the Schedule.

(5) Where the holder of a licence is the holder of

a licence issued under the Goods Vehicles (Licensing of

Drivers) Rules 1965, the fee referred to in subrule (4) shall

not apply.

(6) If the application for renewal of the licence is

made after the date of expiry of the licence, the fee to be

charged shall be as prescribed in items 1 and 3 of Table A of

the Schedule.

3B. (1) An adjustment for the date of expiry of a

licence shall be made once only in accordance with the date

of birth of the holder of a licence.

 (2) The adjustment for the date of expiry of a

licence referred to in subrule (1) shall apply to—

(a) an applicant who applies for a licence;

 and

(b) a holder of a licence who applies for

renewal of a licence upon the expiry

of such licence.

"Fees.

 (3) Where the applicant or the holder of a licence

referred to in subrule (2) whose date of birth falls on

29 February, the date of expiry of his licence is either—

(a) 28 February, if the following

application for renewal of the licence

is made in a year which is not a leap

year; or

(b) 29 February, if the following

application for renewal of the licence

is made in a year which is a leap year,

as the case may be.

(4) The fees to be charged for the purpose of the

adjustment of the date of expiry of a licence shall be as

prescribed in Table B of the Schedule.

(5) Where the applicant or the holder of a licence

referred to in subrule (2) is the applicant or the holder of a

licence issued under the Goods Vehicles (Licensing of

Drivers) Rules 1965, the fee referred to in subrule (4) shall

not apply.".

Pindaan kaedah 5

4. Kaedah-Kaedah ibu dipinda dengan menggantikan kaedah 5 dengan kaedah yang

berikut:

5. (1) The fees for the application or renewal of a

licence and other fees as may be relevant shall be as

prescribed in Table A of the Schedule.

(2) The fees for the adjustment of the date of

expiry of a licence in accordance with the date of birth of

the holder of a licence shall be as prescribed in Table B of

the Schedule.".

Pindaan kaedah 5A

5. Kaedah 5A Kaedah-Kaedah ibu dipinda dengan menggantikan nota birai dengan

nota birai yang berikut:

 "Requirement for renewal of a licence.".

Pemotongan kaedah 6

6. Kaedah-Kaedah ibu dipinda dengan memotong kaedah 6.

Jadual baru
